episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.plot: Fifteen-year-old Angela Chase reinvents her look and social circle by gravitating toward impulsive Rayanne and sensitive Rickie, unsettling her mother while pulling away from the safer version of herself everyone expects.

episodes.title: Dancing in the Dark
episodes.plot: Angela tries to get closer to Jordan Catalano without admitting how much she cares, while Patty and Graham confront the quiet erosion of romance inside their marriage.

episodes.title: Guns and Gossip
episodes.plot: A rumor about Angela spreads through school as Brian and Rickie become entangled in a gun incident, forcing several teenagers to discover how quickly gossip can become something far more serious.

episodes.title: Father Figures
episodes.plot: Patty is pushed into taking control of the family printing business from her father, while Angela begins seeing Graham less as an idealized parent and more as a complicated person.

episodes.title: The Zit
episodes.plot: Angela's breakout and Patty's worries about aging leave mother and daughter measuring themselves against impossible standards of beauty, each assuming the other has it easier.

episodes.title: The Substitute
episodes.plot: An unconventional substitute teacher inspires Liberty High students to write freely, triggering a censorship fight that turns classroom rebellion into a question of who gets to decide what students may say.

episodes.title: Why Jordan Can't Read
episodes.plot: Angela discovers that Jordan struggles to read, creating an unexpectedly honest connection between them while exposing the insecurity hidden beneath his effortless image.

episodes.title: Strangers in the House
episodes.plot: Sharon's father suffers a heart attack, drawing Angela back toward her former best friend as Graham becomes newly conscious of his own mortality and the fragility of family life.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.plot: Angela's fascination with an old Liberty High story turns Halloween strangely supernatural, while Patty and Graham rediscover some playfulness of their own through elaborate costumes.

episodes.title: Other People's Mothers
episodes.plot: Rayanne's reckless night ends in a medical crisis, and Patty becomes the adult Angela least expected to rely on, briefly changing the way mother and daughter understand each other.

episodes.title: Life of Brian
episodes.plot: Brian's longing for Angela, Rickie's outsider status and a school dance expose how isolated nearly everyone feels, while Graham discovers an unexpected confidence in a cooking class.

episodes.title: Self-Esteem
episodes.plot: Angela's secretive relationship with Jordan collides with her self-respect, while Brian, Rickie and Graham each confront different versions of insecurity and the need to be taken seriously.

episodes.title: Pressure
episodes.plot: Angela wrestles with whether she is ready to sleep with Jordan, while Graham faces a very different kind of pressure when Hallie proposes turning his cooking ambitions into a restaurant.

episodes.title: On the Wagon
episodes.plot: After more than a month sober, Rayanne joins Jordan's band and tries to rebuild her life, but stage fright and the discomfort of facing herself without alcohol threaten the progress she has made.

episodes.title: So-Called Angels
episodes.plot: Angela's search for a missing Rickie during Christmas leads her into the world of homeless teenagers and a mysterious girl whose presence forces the Chase family to look beyond its own holiday problems.

episodes.title: Resolutions
episodes.plot: New Year's resolutions expose how unstable several lives have become, with Rickie facing an increasingly difficult home situation while everyone else discovers that promises are easier to make than keep.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.plot: Angela believes she is finally moving beyond Jordan just as Brian captures a betrayal involving Jordan and Rayanne, forcing friendship, desire and loyalty into the same painfully small space.

episodes.title: Weekend
episodes.plot: Patty and Graham attempt a romantic weekend away, while Angela is left dealing with Rayanne and the unresolved damage between them at home.

episodes.title: In Dreams Begin Responsibilities
episodes.plot: Jordan asks Brian to help him express what he cannot say to Angela himself, while Rayanne and Sharon reconsider their friendship and Rickie notices an unexpected new romantic possibility.
